question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing sweeper, Bob is playing cheerleader, Claire is playing benchwarmer, Dave is playing goalkeeper, Eve is playing center midfielder, Fred is playing right back, and Gertrude is playing left back.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Eve and Fred trade positions. Then, Bob and Fred trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Bob trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Bob trade positions. Then, Dave and Fred trade positions. Then, Bob and Eve trade positions. Finally, Dave and Gertrude trade positions. At the end of the match, Claire is playing
Options:
(A) sweeper
(B) cheerleader
(C) benchwarmer
(D) goalkeeper
(E) center midfielder
(F) right back
(G) left back
solution:
Player order in every row: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve | Fred | Gertrude.
Initial: sweeper | cheerleader | benchwarmer | goalkeeper | center midfielder | right back | left back
1. Eve ↔ Fred: sweeper | cheerleader | benchwarmer | goalkeeper | right back | center midfielder | left back
2. Bob ↔ Fred: sweeper | center midfielder | benchwarmer | goalkeeper | right back | cheerleader | left back
3. Gertrude ↔ Bob: sweeper | left back | benchwarmer | goalkeeper | right back | cheerleader | center midfielder
4. Gertrude ↔ Bob: sweeper | center midfielder | benchwarmer | goalkeeper | right back | cheerleader | left back
5. Dave ↔ Fred: sweeper | center midfielder | benchwarmer | cheerleader | right back | goalkeeper | left back
6. Bob ↔ Eve: sweeper | right back | benchwarmer | cheerleader | center midfielder | goalkeeper | left back
7. Dave ↔ Gertrude: sweeper | right back | benchwarmer | left back | center midfielder | goalkeeper | cheerleader
Claire's final position is benchwarmer, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
